description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class `LicenseFileAPI` within the OrangeHRM software. The class extends an abstract controller and provides an endpoint to retrieve the contents of the LICENSE file. It is part of the installer API for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LicenseFileAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for retrieving the LICENSE file content during the installer process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the LICENSE file contents, returning it as an array.
